When is the new website going to be launched?
A. After it gets a final review.
B. Mr. Davies, I think.
C. The shipment arrived on Saturday.

新网站什么时候会发布？
A. 等它经过最终审核之后。
B. 大卫斯先生，我想是您。
C. 货物周六到了。
